CREATE TABLE pc_retained_dream_candidate_versions (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	proposal MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL, 
	source_refs MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL, 
	artifact_refs MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL, 
	target_family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	target_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	target_revision INTEGER, 
	reason MEDIUMTEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, candidate_id, version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_retained_dream_versions_version_positive CHECK (version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_retained_dream_versions_target_complete CHECK ((target_family IS NULL AND target_artifact_id IS NULL AND target_revision IS NULL) OR (target_family IS NOT NULL AND target_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND target_revision > 0))
)

INSERT IGNORE INTO pc_retained_dream_candidate_versions (scope_id, candidate_id, version, family, proposal, source_refs, artifact_refs, target_family, target_artifact_id, target_revision, reason) SELECT scope_id, candidate_id, version, family, proposal, source_refs, artifact_refs, target_family, target_artifact_id, target_revision, reason FROM pc_artifact_candidate_versions

CREATE TABLE pc_retained_dream_candidate_heads (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, 
	result_family VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	result_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, 
	result_revision INTEGER, 
	decision_reason MEDIUMTEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, candidate_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_retained_dream_heads_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_retained_dream_heads_terminal_result CHECK ((status = 'approved' AND result_family IS NOT NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND result_revision > 0 AND decision_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'rejected' AND result_family IS NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NULL AND result_revision IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'pending' AND result_family IS NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NULL AND result_revision IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NULL))
)

INSERT IGNORE INTO pc_retained_dream_candidate_heads (scope_id, candidate_id, family, version, status, result_family, result_artifact_id, result_revision, decision_reason) SELECT scope_id, candidate_id, family, version, status, result_family, result_artifact_id, result_revision, decision_reason FROM pc_artifact_candidate_heads

CREATE TABLE `pc_artifact_handles` (
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `family` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `handle_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `artifact_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`scope_id`, `family`, `handle_key`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`, `revision`) REFERENCES `pc_artifacts`(`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`, `revision`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT ,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_handles_revision_positive` CHECK ((`revision` > 0))
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0

CREATE TABLE `pc_context_bootstrap_receipts` (
  `receipt_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `event_key` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `request_digest` varchar(71) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `integration` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `lifecycle` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `profile` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_bytes` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `package_digest` varchar(71) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `content_bytes` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `truncated` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `items` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`receipt_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`scope_id`) REFERENCES `pc_scopes`(`scope_id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE ,
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pc_context_bootstrap_receipts_event` (`event_key`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  KEY `ix_pc_context_bootstrap_receipts_created_at` (`created_at`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_context_bootstrap_receipts_state` CHECK ((`state` in ('pending','injected','skipped','failed'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_context_bootstrap_receipts_budget` CHECK (((`max_bytes` >= 512) and (`max_bytes` <= 8192))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_context_bootstrap_receipts_content_bytes` CHECK ((`content_bytes` >= 0))
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0

CREATE TABLE `pc_lexical_projection_versions` (

  PRIMARY KEY (`projection`)
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0

CREATE TABLE `pc_topic_memory_work_blocks` (
  `block_id` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `attempt_id` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `binding_name` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_after` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `source_through` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `budget_source_through` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `legacy_source_through` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_source_through` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `requests` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `tokens` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `last_error_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `blocked_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `retried_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `retry_request_generation` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`block_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pc_topic_block_identity` (`scope_id`, `binding_name`, `source_after`, `attempt_id`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_topic_block_window` CHECK (((`source_after` >= 0) and (`target_source_through` > `source_after`) and ((`source_through` is null) or ((`source_through` > `source_after`) and (`source_through` <= `target_source_through`))) and ((`budget_source_through` is null) or ((`budget_source_through` > `source_after`) and (`budget_source_through` <= `target_source_through`))) and ((`source_through` is null) or (`budget_source_through` is null) or (`source_through` <= `budget_source_through`)) and ((`legacy_source_through` is null) or ((`legacy_source_through` > `source_after`) and (`legacy_source_through` <= `target_source_through`))))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_topic_block_usage` CHECK (((`attempts` > 0) and (`requests` >= 0) and (`tokens` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_topic_block_acceptance` CHECK ((((`retried_at` is null) and (`retry_request_generation` is null)) or ((`retried_at` is not null) and (`retry_request_generation` is not null) and (`retry_request_generation` > 0))))
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0

UPDATE pc_artifact_processing_leases SET supervisor_generation=supervisor_generation+1, holder_id='migration-s1400', lease_expires_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE holder_id <> 'migration-s1400' OR lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <> '1970-01-01 00:00:00'
